Title: Mark single attendance with valid employeeId, absent status, and date
Description: Verify that marking attendance for a single employee with valid employeeId, absent status, and a specific date returns 200 OK and the saved attendance record
Pre-Conditions: Employee with employeeId exists in the system
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with JSON body containing employeeId, absent, and date
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains attendance record with matching employeeId, absent status, and date
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with attendance record reflecting employeeId=1001, absent=true, date=2024-06-01

Title: Mark single attendance with valid employeeId and absent status but no date (defaults to today)
Description: Verify that marking attendance for a single employee with valid employeeId and absent status but no date sets the attendance date to current date
Pre-Conditions: Employee with employeeId exists in the system
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with JSON body containing employeeId and absent but no date
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains attendance record with matching employeeId, absent status, and date equals current date
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with attendance record reflecting employeeId=1002, absent=false, date=current system date

Title: Mark single attendance with missing employeeId
Description: Verify that marking attendance without employeeId returns 400 Bad Request with appropriate error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with JSON body missing employeeId
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with JSON body {"message":"employeeId and absent required"}

Title: Mark single attendance with missing absent status
Description: Verify that marking attendance without absent status returns 400 Bad Request with appropriate error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with JSON body missing absent field
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with JSON body {"message":"employeeId and absent required"}

Title: Mark single attendance with null request body
Description: Verify that marking attendance with null request body returns 400 Bad Request with appropriate error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with null body
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with JSON body {"message":"employeeId and absent required"}

Title: Mark batch attendance with valid list of attendance records
Description: Verify that marking batch attendance with valid list of attendance DTOs returns 200 OK with correct counts and saved records
Pre-Conditions: Employees with given employeeIds exist in the system
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with JSON array of valid attendance DTOs
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains savedCount equal to number of valid entries
Verify presentCount and absentCount are correct based on input
Verify savedRecords contains attendance records matching input data
Verify invalidEntries list is empty
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with JSON body containing savedCount=2, presentCount=1, absentCount=1, savedRecords with 2 attendance records, invalidEntries empty

Title: Mark batch attendance with some invalid entries (missing absent field)
Description: Verify that batch attendance marking skips invalid entries missing absent field and returns them in invalidEntries list
Pre-Conditions: Employees with given employeeIds exist in the system
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with JSON array containing some valid and some invalid attendance DTOs (missing absent)
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify savedCount equals number of valid entries
Verify invalidEntries contains employeeIds of invalid entries
Verify presentCount and absentCount counts are correct
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with savedCount=2, invalidEntries containing [1003], presentCount and absentCount reflecting valid entries

Title: Mark batch attendance with empty payload
Description: Verify that batch attendance marking with empty list returns 400 Bad Request with appropriate error message
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with empty JSON array
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'payload is empty'
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with JSON body {"message":"payload is empty"}

Title: Mark batch attendance with null payload
Description: Verify that batch attendance marking with null payload returns 400 Bad Request with appropriate error message
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with null body
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'payload is empty'
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with JSON body {"message":"payload is empty"}

Title: Mark batch attendance with entries missing employeeId
Description: Verify that batch attendance marking skips entries missing employeeId and does not add them to invalidEntries list
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with JSON array containing entries missing employeeId
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify invalidEntries list does not contain null employeeIds
Verify savedCount reflects only valid entries
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with savedCount=1, invalidEntries empty or does not contain null, savedRecords contains only valid entry

Title: Mark single attendance for non-existent employee
Description: Verify that marking attendance for an employeeId not present in employee repository still creates attendance record but does not update employee counters
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given employeeId does not exist
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with valid employeeId not in system
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify attendance record is created with given employeeId
Verify no error occurs due to missing employee record
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with attendance record created for employeeId=9999, no employee counters updated

Title: Mark single attendance updates existing attendance record and employee counters
Description: Verify that marking attendance for an existing attendance record updates the absent status and adjusts employee present/absent counters accordingly
Pre-Conditions: Attendance record exists for employeeId and date with absent=false
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with same employeeId and date but absent=true
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify attendance record absent status is updated to true
Verify employee totalPresent decremented by 1 and totalAbsent incremented by 1
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with updated attendance record absent=true, employee counters updated accordingly

Title: Mark batch attendance with all entries missing required fields
Description: Verify that batch attendance marking with all entries missing employeeId or absent returns 200 OK with savedCount=0 and invalidEntries containing all employeeIds present
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with JSON array of DTOs all missing employeeId or absent
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify savedCount=0
Verify invalidEntries contains employeeIds of entries that had employeeId but missing absent
Verify savedRecords is empty
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with savedCount=0, invalidEntries=[1007], savedRecords empty

Title: Mark batch attendance with null entries in payload
Description: Verify that batch attendance marking skips null entries in the payload and processes valid entries correctly
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with JSON array containing null and valid AttendanceDTO objects
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify savedCount equals number of valid entries
Verify invalidEntries does not include null entries
Verify savedRecords contains only valid attendance records
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with savedCount=1, invalidEntries empty, savedRecords contains one attendance record
